title: C: Matrix Multiplication
description: Multiply two 3x3 matrices and print the result.

steps.title: Multiply 3x3 Matrices
steps.description: Declare two 3x3 matrices A and B. Compute C = A * B using nested loops. Print the resulting matrix in a 3x3 grid format.
hints: Matrix multiplication: C[i][j] = sum over k of A[i][k] * B[k][j].
Three nested loops: i, j, k.
